主要内容: SouthCorp Capital, Inc. filed for permits to begin construction on the initial buildings for its factory in Indiana. The building will be capable of producing up to 27 million cans per year, representing the initial phase of a factory capable of producing 50 million cans per year. The company has begun discussions with Nate’s Food Co. to build a factory in Indiana with a capacity of 50-100 million cans per year. SouthCorp Capital currently owns industrial and commercial property in Indiana that will be used as the site for the factory and storage. As part of these discussions, SouthCorp agreed to purchase equipment for its Fairfield, California location for approximately $400,000 in exchange for a per can sold fee from Nate’s Food. The equipment will be part of the planned expansion of the facilities in Fairfield, California while the Indiana factory is built.
